full_judgment: Bimalendu Bikash Roy Choudhury, J : This petition for leave to appeal is from the judgment and order dated 29 February 1996 passed by a Division Bench of the High Court Division, in Criminal Revision No. 344 of 1987, under Section 561-A of the Code of Criminal Procedure, by which the proceeding pending against the respondent of G.R. Case No. 1050 of 1987, started at the instance of the petitioner in the Court of the Metropolitan Magistrate. Dhaka were quashed. It is out of time by 18 days. But for the reasons stated in the application under Section 5 of the Limitation Act we condoned the delay.
